$comment: Information architecture for the trymirai-clone React codebase (src/App.jsx + src/pages/*.jsx + src/components/*.jsx). Route -> template grouping and section inventory are kept consistent with the sibling design-repo/ (templates/templates.json, sections/*.json), which was built and verified earlier this session from the same source files. Section ids, categories and granularity are the IA's own vocabulary (a structure map for humans) and differ in naming from the design-repo's machine content-contract ids, but the same real page is never split into two templates in one artifact and one in the other.

meta.source: Local codebase at /Users/riyaghosh/V2 cloned/Mirai — a React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind v3 reference clone of the live site trymirai.com (Mirai Labs). Content, branding and design belong to Mirai Labs; this IA documents the clone's own code structure, not a page it owns rights to (see design-repo/registry.manifest.json's sourceProject note and README.md).
meta.mirror: measured directly from src/App.jsx and src/pages/*.jsx in this repo, cross-checked against design-repo/templates/templates.json
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill, manual read of src/App.jsx + every src/pages/*.jsx file, paired with the existing design-repo/

categories.SHELL: Chrome present on every route: sticky top navigation and the site footer.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block: full hero treatment on marketing pages, or a lighter page-top header/title band on utility pages.
categories.FEATURES: Product/capability explanation modules — the mid-page blocks that explain what the product does or how to use it.
categories.PROOF: Benchmarks, metrics and structured comparison data: charts, stat panels, scatter plots, model/family listings.
categories.CONTENT: Substantive body content unique to a page: prose, article bodies, card lists, legal text.
categories.CTA: Closing calls-to-action: statement + primary action band near the bottom of a page.
categories.FORM: Interactive input surfaces — currently just the contact/interest form.

shell.navbar.description: Sticky top navigation bar: collapsing logo, Product/Company dropdowns, direct links, present identically at the top of all 14 routes.
shell.navbar.scope: All 14 routes (13 real routes + the 404 catch-all).

shell.footer.description: Site footer: logo rail plus Main/Company/Links columns, present at the bottom of all 14 routes.
shell.footer.scope: All 14 routes (13 real routes + the 404 catch-all).

hero.home.description: Homepage hero: headline, supporting copy, and the primary chat/app visual composition. Not wrapped in scroll-reveal — renders immediately above the fold.

hero.product.description: Product-page hero: eyebrow label + hairline rule, serif title, supporting paragraph, CTA row. Shared shape between the two product pages.

hero.chat-mac.description: Full-bleed sunset-backdrop hero for the macOS app page: app icon, serif headline, supporting copy, download CTA.

hero.about.description: Centered 720px About hero heading with no supporting paragraph, followed by a full-width divider.

hero.blog-header.description: Centered blog index header: h1 + one line of supporting copy.

hero.metrics-header.description: Metrics page-top header: 'Metrics' h1, small caption line, lead paragraph.

hero.page-header-simple.description: Minimal page-top h1 with no subtitle, left/top-aligned in the shell padding band — the lightest header treatment used on this site.

hero.page-header-centered.description: Centered page-top eyebrow + h1, used where the page opens with a short label above the title.

features.appgrid.description: 'One interface' section: convergence-wires illustration showing model/runtime/device tying together.

features.speed.description: Dark full-bleed 'speed' section with a tokens/sec chart illustration.

features.cloud-vs-device.description: Short comparison band contrasting cloud vs. on-device inference.

features.toolkit-convert-cards.description: Two side-by-side beige cards: one-command conversion, add new architecture support.

features.toolkit-pipeline.description: Three-up pipeline card grid: draft-model training, quantization, validation.

features.runtime-install-steps.description: 3-step framework picker + install command + syntax-highlighted code sample.

features.runtime-install-matrix.description: Language/distribution/snippet install matrix table plus a promise list and 'Read the docs' link.

features.runtime-features.description: Two-column feature accordion (dark cards) beside a photo plate with a floating badge.

features.framed-screenshot.description: One real product screenshot rendered full-bleed inside a Frame, with separate desktop/mobile crops.

proof.bench-strip.description: 'What Apple Silicon delivers today' benchmark strip: three stat panels (output/input speed, etc).

proof.model-cards.description: Grid of model-family cards linking through to /local-models.

proof.metrics-sidebar-nav.description: Sticky left-hand in-page nav (200px, desktop only) linking to the 5 metrics sections.

proof.metrics-chart-panel.description: One bordered, radius-8 panel: title + model count, runner legend, horizontally-scrollable grouped bar chart, versions/methodology footer. Repeats 3 times per page.

proof.metrics-quality-scatter.description: Quantization-quality scatter plot panel (speed vs. quality-retained).

proof.metrics-how-we-measure.description: Methodology explainer panel closing the metrics page.

proof.model-family-list.description: Repeated family sections: logo + name + provenance, a horizontally-scrolling checkpoint/variant table per family.

content.about-prose-block.description: Single-column 600px article block: h2 + 1-3 paragraphs, occasionally followed by an inline element. Repeats 5-6 times down the About page.

content.about-team-cards.description: Two 302px beige team cards: generic circular avatar + role label + withheld-biography treatment.

content.about-backer-grid.description: 4-up (2-up mobile) grid of 160px investor/backer logo cards.

content.careers-roles-list.description: Open-positions list: bordered beige rows, title + meta line, each linking to the contact route.

content.careers-about-why.description: Two-column 'About us' / 'Why us?' copy blocks, single column on mobile.

content.blog-post-list.description: Vertical list of post cards, cover image left, tag/title/blurb right.

content.blog-post-article.description: Single-post article body: tag, h1, blurb, cover image, and a disclosure that the post content is placeholder for this clone.

content.legal-body.description: Narrow 720px legal-page body: h1, a structural disclosure paragraph, then N hairline-divided clauses. Same component renders both privacy policy and terms of use via a `kind` prop.

content.contact-frame.description: Framed contact panel: desktop 1200x696 Frame with a centered 600x482 mail-style form card; separate mobile layout.

content.notfound-body.description: Centered 404 body: h1, supporting line, 'Back home' CTA.

cta.closing-home.description: Homepage closing statement: 240px orbital mark + serif headline + supporting line + primary action.

cta.closing-band.description: Full-bleed closing CTA band: photo plate with a floating terminal card and a primary action.

cta.careers-closing-cta.description: Closing statement: orbital mark, serif heading, supporting line, and a full-width action.
